$comment: Developer Harness V2 Phase 3 — hand-curated semantic consolidation of repeated Do-Not-Repeat lessons, plus the short essentials list rendered into .wolf/cerebrum.md. Members are K-ids from .wolf/knowledge/_provenance.json. Members are RETAINED verbatim in the topic files (each carries some unique detail); a cluster records which consolidated lesson they repeat. Advisory data only.

clusters.lesson: On Windows, never edit repo files with Python text mode: use the Edit/Write tool, or open(p, encoding='utf-8', newline='') for BOTH read and write. Text mode rewrites LF as CRLF (whole-file diffs) and mangles non-ASCII via cp1252.
Do not write source files or regex-heavy code through Bash heredocs: apostrophes/quotes cause 'unexpected EOF' and escapes get mangled. Use the Write/Edit tool.
apps/api/RBAC-MATRIX.md records route line numbers: after adding or moving code in apps/api/routers/*.py, regenerate it last, before committing.
The Expo web harness needs a dummy EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY or rendering throws 'supabaseKey is required'.
Run API tests as `pytest tests/` with the apps/api/.venv interpreter (tests/smoke/conftest.py sets env vars; a worktree may have no venv).
Jest mocks and hooks must keep stable references (module-level objects, honor selectors); fresh objects/arrays per render loop effects.
Hotel-local dates come from the tenant time zone, never the device clock or toISOString() UTC dates.

essentials.text: Migrations are forward-only: never edit an applied migration, never `supabase migration repair`; destructive CHECK changes need the `destructive-reviewed` + `rollback-plan` headers.
A migration file on disk is not proof it was applied to a live project; check the applied head.
Check existing migration numbers (note `0201_*` sets the numeric ceiling) before adding one.
Every Supabase query scopes to the tenant; RLS is a second layer, not a substitute.
Windows file edits: Edit/Write tool or `newline=''` + utf-8 (cluster C01). No source files via Bash heredocs (C02).
API tests: `pytest tests/` with the `apps/api/.venv` interpreter (C05).
Business rules enforced in one endpoint must be enforced on every route that reaches that state.
Hotel-local dates use the tenant time zone (C07).
Append to `.wolf/buglog.json` textually; never re-dump it with json.dump.
A root `npm ci` in a worktree can break `apps/web` types; install per app.
